title: 第22章 地面纹饰第23章 褐色石块
content_zh:
第22章地面纹饰
被众人逼视，钱半仙缩了缩脖子，道：“大家误会了，我不是坑杜成金，也是为了试探危险出现的规律啊。”
“你还狡辩？”虎镇嵩怒道。
众怒难犯，钱半仙连忙解释道：“其实青阳小道士说第一句话的时候我就想到了，无论是虎镇衡，还是那只豹，出现问题的时候好像都是踩到了上面有纹饰的石块，后来杜成金连续两次踏在空白石块上都没有出问题，就更证明了这个规律。为了进一步验证那些有纹饰的石块与凭空出现的危险有什么关联，于是我才出声让他站在一块有风形纹饰的石块上，后来果然就出现了两道风刃。”
听了他的解释，大家不由得把目光投向了地面，正如钱半仙所说，这边地面的石块上都刻着一些纹饰，种类很多，有兵刃，有雷电，有树木，也有火球等等，几乎每块石头上都有，大家也就没当回事。
此时他们才发现，其中也有一些石块是空白的，只是数量比较少，需要仔细观察才能够找到。原来所有的问题都出现在这里，那些纹饰竟然就是危险的来源，幸亏青阳小道士发现的早，否则的话还不知道要用多少条人命才能试出来。大家不由得暗自庆幸，多亏仙师们让这个青阳也进来了，否则的话还不知道要死几个人才能试出来呢。
钱半仙的解释勉强也能说得通，虽然大家明知道他有私心，更多的为了报复前几天杜成金追杀他的仇，可钱半仙说的也有一定的道理，没有这一下，也就无法证明那些纹饰的作用。
只是这个验证的过程太过残忍，杜成金为此失去了一条手臂，若不是青阳及时出声相救，说不定连性命都要丢掉。
弄明白了那些杀招是如何出现的，所有人都松了一口气，大家怕的不是危险本身，而是不知道危险从何而来，又什么时候出现。如今找到了其中的规律，只要小心一些就不会再有危险了。
杜成金用钱半仙说出来的规律，试探着找到空白的石块，很快就回到了大家的身边。或许是因为刚刚失去了一条右臂，知道自己暂时不是钱半仙的对手，杜成金也就没有去找钱半仙的麻烦，只是每次看到钱半仙时，目光中都带着浓浓的杀气。
杜成金一来一回都没事，大家也就彻底放心了，有那好奇心比较强的，还专门进去走了一遭，证明钱半仙说的都是真的。
虎镇华甚至还专门在一块刻有火焰纹饰的石块上踩了一脚，踩上之后迅速后退，石块上面就凭空生出了一团火焰。那火焰温度奇高，似乎不比外面那溪宁仙师发出的火焰差多少，只是虎镇华逃得快，那火焰转眼就消失了，连他的衣角都没烧到。
危险彻底解除，虎镇嵩也进去走了一趟，把地上的三具尸体都搬了回来。青阳特意上前观察了一番，其中两具是猛虎帮的帮众，有一具全身焦黑，已经看不出人的模样，估计是被雷击的，另外一具还能看清模样，是个一身短打装扮的青年武者，尸体被斩成了两断。
剩下的那一具就是虎镇嵩说的溪松仙师的尸体，虽然死了半个多月了，尸体保存的还很完整，皮肤上甚至还能看到点点荧光。
这溪松仙师的年纪与外面的溪平仙师差不多，穿着一身青色仙衣，胸口部位绣着灵溪谷三个小字，灵溪谷代表的应该就是这溪松仙师的门派或身份了。他腰间还插着一根长箫，只是胸口部位有个碗大的洞口，可能是被什么东西穿胸而死，只是没有找到相应的凶器。
松鹤老道伸手在那衣服上摸了一遍，感叹道：“果然是仙师才能穿的衣服，跟我们普通人的就是不一样。”
虎镇嵩没有来得及阻止，连忙说道：“松鹤真人住手，哪怕是仙师的尸体，也不是我们能够随便亵渎的。溪英仙师有交代，回去的时候要把溪松仙师的尸体带回去，他身上的东西也一件都不能少。”
松鹤老道连忙收回手，讪讪的说道：“我也就是一时好奇，怎么敢亵渎仙师的尸体？这尸体还是给你们猛虎帮看管吧，若是丢了什么东西，把我老道卖了也赔不起。”
大家马上就要进去探险，尸体肯定不能随身携带，只好把受伤的虎镇嵩留在这里，让他一边疗伤，一边帮忙照看尸体。
剩下的十二个人，无论是断了一臂的杜成金，还是重伤未愈的钱半仙，都要跟着猛虎帮继续往前走。这处地面有纹饰的通道大约有数十丈长，既然已经找到了他的规律，想要通过就简单多了，甚至连青阳等几个小孩都不需要帮忙，蹦蹦跳跳就通过了这处阵法区域。

通过这阵法区，前面是一条岔道，虎镇嵩对这里也不熟悉，商量过之后，认为还是不分开为好，大家先从左边走，若是道路不通就返回来，每条岔道都能探索一遍，尽量完成仙师交代的任务。
这边的通道宽阔了很多，应该不至于布置什么机关陷阱，不过有了前面的教训，大家不敢大意，所有人都分散开，慢慢的试探着往前走，为了避免出现伤亡，皮应熊的那只猴子又被派到了最前面。
皮应熊很不情愿，为什么每次都是自己出力？可人命终究是比驯兽的性命重要，他也只能照办，或许等什么时候这只猴子也死了，猛虎帮才有可能放过他。
或许是皮应熊暗中的祷告起了作用，之后他们再也没有遇到什么危险，不知不觉一个时辰就过去了。只是大家行走的速度很慢，这么长时间，也才走了不到四五里的路。
从早上到现在，除了在外面山洞里等待裂缝出现的时候，稍微吃了点东西，之后就是一连串的担惊受怕，就没有认真休息过，也没机会吃点东西补充体力。精神一直这么绷着，江湖高手也受不了，于是大家就暂时停了下来，休息一会儿，吃点东西。
每个人都背着包袱，里面带了不少的干粮和清水，只是他们要在这个密地之中呆很长时间，干粮和清水必须省着点用，否则的话根本就坚持不到半个月之后仙师们再次打开那裂缝。
感谢虚无缥缈210的打赏，临时加更一章。
（本章完）
content_en:
Chapter 22 Ground Decoration
Being stared at by everyone, Qian Banxian shrank his neck and said: "Everyone has misunderstood. I am not tricking Du Chengjin, but also to test the pattern of danger."
"Are you still making excuses?" Hu Zhensong said angrily.
It was easy to get angry, Qian Banxian quickly explained: "Actually, when the little Taoist priest Qingyang said the first sentence, I thought that whether it was Hu Zhenheng or the leopard, when problems occurred, they seemed to have stepped on stones with patterns on them. Later, Du Chengjin stepped on the blank space twice in a row. There were no problems on the stones, which further proved this rule. In order to further verify the connection between the stones with patterns and the danger that appeared out of thin air, I asked him to stand on a stone with wind-shaped patterns, and then two wind blades appeared. "
After listening to his explanation, everyone couldn't help but turn their attention to the ground. As Qian Banxian said, the stones on the ground here were engraved with some patterns. There were many types, including weapons, thunder and lightning, trees, fireballs, etc. They were found on almost every stone, so everyone didn't take it seriously.
Only then did they discover that some of the stones were blank, but the number was relatively small and required careful observation to find them. It turns out that all the problems appeared here, and those patterns turned out to be the source of danger. Fortunately, the little Taoist priest Qingyang discovered it early, otherwise I don't know how many lives it would have taken to try it out. Everyone couldn't help but secretly rejoice, thanks to the immortal masters for letting this Qingyang come in, otherwise, I don't know how many people would have died to try it out.
Qian Banxian's explanation barely made sense. Although everyone knew that he had selfish motives and was more interested in revenge for Du Chengjin's pursuit of him a few days ago, Qian Banxian's explanation also made sense. Without this, it would be impossible to prove the role of those patterns.
It's just that this verification process was too cruel, and Du Chengjin lost an arm. If Qingyang hadn't come to the rescue in time, he might even have lost his life.
After understanding how those killing moves appeared, everyone breathed a sigh of relief. What everyone was afraid of was not the danger itself, but not knowing where the danger came from and when it would appear. Now that we have found the rules, as long as we are careful, we will no longer be in danger.
Du Chengjin used the rules mentioned by Qian Banxian to tentatively find blank stones, and soon returned to everyone. Perhaps because he had just lost his right arm and knew that he was no match for Qian Banxian for the time being, Du Chengjin did not go to trouble Qian Banxian, but every time he saw Qian Banxian, there was a strong murderous look in his eyes.
Du Chengjin came and went and everything was fine, so everyone was completely relieved. The one who was more curious even went in for a walk to prove that what Qian Banxian said was true.
Hu Zhenhua even stepped on a stone engraved with flame patterns. After stepping on it, he quickly retreated, and a flame appeared out of thin air on the stone. The temperature of the flame was extremely high, and it seemed not much worse than the flame emitted by Immortal Master Xi Ning outside. However, Hu Zhenhua escaped quickly, and the flame disappeared in the blink of an eye, without even burning the corners of his clothes.
When the danger was completely eliminated, Hu Zhensong also went in and brought back the three corpses on the ground. Qingyang stepped forward specifically to observe. Two of them were members of the Tiger Gang. One was charred all over and his human appearance was no longer visible. He was probably struck by lightning. The other one could still see his appearance clearly. He was a young warrior in short-sleeve attire. His body was chopped into two pieces.
The remaining body is the body of Immortal Master Xisong that Hu Zhensong mentioned. Although it has been dead for more than half a month, the body is still very well preserved, and you can even see a little fluorescence on the skin.
This Immortal Master Xisong is about the same age as the Immortal Master Xiping outside. He is wearing a green Immortal Clothes with three small characters Lingxi Valley embroidered on his chest. Lingxi Valley should represent the sect or identity of Immortal Master Xisong.. There was a long flute stuck in his waist, but there was a hole as big as a bowl in his chest. He might have been killed by something piercing his chest, but no corresponding murder weapon was found.
Old Taoist Songhe reached out and touched the clothes again, and sighed: "It is indeed clothes that can only be worn by immortal masters. They are just different from those worn by us ordinary people."
Hu Zhensong didn't have time to stop him and said quickly: "Master Songhe, stop it. Even if it's the body of the Immortal Master, we can't desecrate it casually. Immortal Master Xiying has given instructions to take the body of the Immortal Master Xisong back when he goes back, and not a single thing on his body should be missing."
Old Taoist Songhe quickly retracted his hand and said coquettishly: "I was just curious for a moment, how dare you desecrate the body of the immortal master? This body should be taken care of by your Tiger Gang. If anything is lost, I can't afford to sell it to you."
Everyone was about to go on an adventure, and they couldn't take the body with them, so they had to leave the injured Hu Zhensong here and let him help take care of the body while he healed his injuries.
The remaining twelve people, whether it was Du Chengjin who had a broken arm or Qian Banxian who was still seriously injured, must continue to move forward with the Tiger Gang. The passage with patterns on the ground is about tens of feet long. Now that he has found his pattern, it is much easier to pass through. Even Qingyang and other children did not need help and jumped through this formation area.
After passing through this formation area, there is a branch road in front. Hu Zhensong is not familiar with this place. After discussion, he thinks it is better not to separate. Everyone goes to the left first. If the road is blocked, go back. You can explore every branch road and try to complete the tasks assigned by the immortal master.
The passage here is much wider, and there should be no traps. However, with the previous lessons, everyone did not dare to be careless. Everyone spread out and slowly and tentatively moved forward. In order to avoid casualties, Pi Yingxiong's monkey was sent to the front again.
Pi Yingxiong was very reluctant. Why did he do his own part every time? But after all, human life is more important than the life of a tame animal, so he can only do as he is told. Maybe when the monkey dies too, the Tiger Gang will be able to let him go.
Perhaps Pi Yingxiong's secret prayer had an effect. They never encountered any danger after that, and an hour passed before they knew it. It’s just that everyone walked very slowly. It took such a long time to cover less than four or five miles.
From morning to now, except for eating a little while waiting for the crack to appear in the cave outside, and then a series of worries, I have not had any serious rest, and I have not had the opportunity to eat something to replenish my strength. Even the martial arts masters couldn't stand being so tense all the time, so everyone stopped temporarily, rested for a while, and had something to eat.
Everyone is carrying a bag with a lot of dry food and water inside. However, they have to stay in this secret place for a long time. The dry food and water must be used sparingly. Otherwise, they will not be able to persist for less than half a month. After half a month, the immortal masters will open the crack again.
Thanks to Wu Miao Miao 210 for the reward, I will add a chapter temporarily.
(End of chapter)
